name: the Pafogai Du grand library
about: The grand library inside the pyramid, a maze of paper books with computer terminals (chapters 19 and 24). The book gives only the details listed below; the rest of the design is invented, and contributors are welcome to replace it.

a drawing of a river horse reading a book, with a backdrop of a marsh with green trees and a blue sky

facts.quote: a drawing of a hamster sitting at a computer
facts.fact: Right of the door: a hamster at a computer.

facts.quote: the entire wall was a large shelf, about five meters tall, filled with physical paper books

facts.quote: allowing the roof of the lower half to serve as a walkway
facts.fact: The upper half is set back behind a walkway.
